title: Record forms use the platform date picker, not the browser's native date input
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, Create Opportunity (`/crm_opportunity?form=new`) in an English console: the Close Date field is a native `<input type=date>` and shows the browser's own placeholder "年/月/日" (the machine's locale), while every other control follows the app's locale and theme; it also cannot show the app's date format, min/max or the relative shortcuts the list filters offer.

## Target

1. Date and date-time fields in record forms render the console's date picker (the one the list filter and the calendar use): a text field in the app's locale format with a calendar popover, keyboard entry, clear, and today / tomorrow shortcuts.
2. The value written is unchanged (ISO date / date-time).
3. The native input stays as the fallback only where the picker is not loaded.

## File surface

`packages/plugin-form/src/` date field renderer, `packages/fields` date widgets, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a date field renders the picker with the app locale's format; typing a date writes ISO.
2. Screenshot of the Create Opportunity form at 1280 px, light and dark.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form test`, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields test` green.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the temporary branch `claude/console-home-login-design-20261016` of objectstack-ai/objectui (commit `b72c97985`, never merged): [hotcrm-create-opportunity-native-date.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/b72c97985/docs/design/hotcrm-review-2026-10-16/hotcrm-create-opportunity-native-date.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 walk of HotCRM's core pages as a user: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en). The maintainer asked for the findings to be filed on the repository each belongs to, verbatim: 「相关问题也在对应的项目上创建任务」.</sub>
